game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables, the sleigh stables: the hold guard must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Default Armory: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables: the sleigh stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Sleigh Stables, repeat each round: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing. Each round, a new hot soup pots challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the armor value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 420 points of hot soup pots by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 420, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Default Armory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Default Armory' (Week 6 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sleigh Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how armor changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Sleigh Stables.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 420 within 54 seconds.
